---
title: "Sampling density within five-minute buckets"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

**1 observation per bucket ≈ every 5 minutes; 5 observations ≈ every minute.**
Missing recordings can reduce these counts.

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

triggerR <- new.env()
source("R/read_data.R", local = triggerR)
if (!exists("trigger_5min")) trigger_5min <- triggerR$read_trigger_5min()
```

Percentages use buckets with `n > 0`, pooled across participants; zero/missing
counts and `sleeprate` are excluded. GPS coordinates have no individual counts.

```{r}
counts <- trigger_5min %>%
  select(origin, variable, n) %>%
  filter(!is.na(n), n > 0) %>%
  count(origin, variable, n, name = "buckets") %>%
  group_by(origin, variable) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * buckets / sum(buckets)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
plot_counts <- function(source) {
  counts %>%
    filter(origin == source) %>%
    ggplot(aes(n, percent)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#2878A5", width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(percent >= 5, sprintf("%.1f%%", percent), "")),
              vjust = -0.4, size = 3.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, ncol = 3) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(counts$n))) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100), limits = c(0, 110),
                       labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
    labs(x = "Observations per five-minute bucket", y = "Observed buckets (%)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
}
```

## myair

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10
p_air <- plot_counts("myair")
p_air
```

## smartwatchhigh

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 3
p_high <- plot_counts("smartwatchhigh")
p_high
```

## smartwatchlow

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
p_low <- plot_counts("smartwatchlow")
p_low
```

## gps

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3
p_gps <- plot_counts("gps")
p_gps
```

Five minutes provides a common time base. `smartwatchlow` shows both 1 and 5
observations per bucket, rather than a single uniform recording interval.
